name: Comic Con Portugal
blurb: The biggest pop-culture convention in Portugal, now a biennial event at Europarque covering film, TV, gaming, comics, anime and cosplay.
notes: The batch URL (www.comicconportugal.pt) and also www.comic-con-portugal.com and www.comicconportugal.com fail to resolve/connect; the real live site is evento.comic-con-portugal.com, which is a content-light teaser page (no dates, no links captured) rather than a full event site. Comic Con Portugal relocated from FIL Lisboa to Europarque in Santa Maria da Feira starting with its April 23-26, 2026 edition, and in doing so switched to a biennial schedule — press coverage (sapo.pt, geekinout.pt, otakupt.com) confirms the next edition is April 21-25, 2028 (its first 5-day edition, on a venue deal covering 2026/2028/2030), with no 2027 edition at all. Since 2028 starts after this run's window (2026-10-05 to 2027-12-31), editions is empty and the last confirmed (and now past) edition is recorded instead.
